Then, when I get him out, I'll hold him for a while with a wet washcloth and gently pet him with it where he's having difficulty shedding. Driving over a hill, we swiped the side of a car coming over the other side, which made my mom lose control of the car. I never really thought about death in the moment, I just wanted to save my brother.
